language.funFactText: The first talking machine was built in 1791 by the Austro-Hungarian inventor Wolfgang von Kempelen. She was my ancestor! And could proudly pronounce "Constantinople". Not bad, right?

business.funFactText: MrCall was born in Italy — and so was the idea of a personal assistant! Ancient Romans had a Nomenclator, a specialised slave whose sole job was to memorise the names, faces and social standing of every person their master might encounter. MrCall does the same thing… but is politically correct.

searchbusinessfunfact.funFactText: The Yellow Pages were invented in 1883 because a printer in Cheyenne, Wyoming ran out of white paper. It became the world's first business directory. Today, we're skipping the paper and the on-hold music. Let's link your Google Business so your assistant can start taking calls right away.

assistantcreatedfunfact.funFactText: Before voicemail was a digital file, it was a human being with a notepad. In the 1930s, the first 'answering machine' was a cabinet the size of a fridge. Today, MrCall is your personal operator — no fridge-sized equipment or whistling required.
